expectations.text: Keeps the accompanying asset kit deliberately minimal (photos, a presentation template, one contact-request email) rather than a sprawling toolkit
expectations.evidence: The transcript never defines an asset kit for sponsors. It describes an intake form, a checklist or welcome email generated from the perk matrix, a perk matrix, and post-event reports. Photos come up only inside the Silvers' recap email. It mentions no presentation template and no contact-request email, and it never says the kit should stay small on purpose. Its closing offer to build the matrix skeleton, welcome email and intake form adds more deliverables instead.

expectations.evidence: The transcript covers how to run sponsor kickoff calls: individual calls, a group call, a one-page written brief and a tracking sheet. It never mentions an asset kit made of photos, a presentation template or a contact-request email. The written brief and shared sheet are process materials, not that asset kit, so the item is absent.
